# ZothPen

> ZothPen is a free, single-page, offline-capable offensive security field
> manual and course that runs entirely in the browser. It covers penetration
> testing and ethical hacking against systems you own or are authorised to
> test: 16 modules, 70 tool dossiers, 16 hands-on labs, 74 graded drills and
> 17 scripting recipes. No backend, no accounts, no telemetry.

Live: https://zothpen.netlify.app
Source: https://github.com/1nc0gn30/zothpen

## Course structure

- 16 modules (m00 scoping & legality → m15 Active Directory & pivoting).
- 70 tool dossiers with real flags, syntax and examples (nmap, Metasploit,
  Burp Suite, sqlmap, hashcat, ffuf, impacket, BloodHound, ...).
- 16 hands-on labs: copy-paste methodology against lab targets you control.
- 74 drills: multiple-choice with explanations and XP.
- 17 Forge recipes: hardening and automation scripts in bash, python, ruby,
  lua and powershell.
- Progress (XP, streaks, completed lessons) is stored in localStorage only.

## How to cite

ZothPen — offensive security field manual. https://zothpen.netlify.app
Built by @1nc0gn30 / NullAI.

## Scope

Everything is for authorised security testing only. Module 00 covers legal
scoping and rules of engagement.
